Class InfoBox

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.AbstractPanelElement<InfoBox>
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.InfoBox
All Implemented Interfaces:
PanelElement
public class InfoBox extends AbstractPanelElement<InfoBox>
A persistent info box rendered at a declared panel position. Auto-sizes to its text content and draws with a PanelStyle.RAISED background.

Distinct from the hover-triggered tooltip set via .tooltip(...) on interactive elements (Button, Toggle, Checkbox, Radio, Icon). That form uses vanilla's tooltip rendering at the mouse position. This form renders at a declared position persistently. The element was renamed from Tooltip to InfoBox to remove the name collision with the .tooltip(...) hover-tooltip chainable that lives on every element.

Works in all three rendering contexts. Render-only element.

Dynamic-width limitation with supplier text

Auto-sizing elements with supplier-based variable content cannot guarantee layout stability — if the supplier returns different-length text each frame, the element's width changes per frame but panel layout is not re-resolved per frame. Consumers needing stable layout should use fixed-content variants or ensure the supplier returns same-width content across evaluations.

      public void render(RenderContext ctx)
      Description copied from interface: PanelElement
      Renders this element. Called during the panel background pass (screen space), after slot backgrounds.

int sy = ctx.originY() + getChildY();
